findings.message: 1 headline(s) wrap past two lines at 1440px: "We run the tech. You run the business." → 4 lines (8 words, 91.3px)
findings.fix:
Cut words first (a headline is a title, not a sentence). Then give it a wider measure. Lower the size only as a last resort and never below the scale you chose. A real statement paragraph belongs in a

or

at 36px or less.

findings.message: 8 eyebrow/kicker label(s) above headings: "Premium digital operations team" (pill) above "We run the tech. You run the business."; "Robust Solutions" above "Senior operators for the systems that gr"; "Full service catalog" above "22 services, one accountable team."; "Global Operations Network" above "Built for fast moving teams across time "; "Client Reviews" above "Trusted by businesses worldwide."
findings.fix: Delete them. If the label carried real information, fold it into the headline or the supporting sentence.

findings.message: Monospace type outside code: ui-monospace — e.g. "04:21:14 AM", "03:51:14 PM", "04:51:14 PM", "06:51:14 PM"
findings.fix: Set it in the text face. Monospace is for literal code inside <pre>/<code> only.

findings.message: 36 tiny uppercase letter-spaced labels (e.g. "Robust Solutions", "Full service catalog", "Global Operations Network", "Drag to rotate · auto-spins when idle").
findings.fix: Use sentence-case text at a readable size, or delete the label.

findings.message: 32 gradient fill(s): div.dust-field → radial-gradient(circle at 12% 18%, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.18) 0px, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.18) 1px, rgba(0, 0, 0, | div.relative.-mt-24 → radial-gradient(70% 48% at 72% 6%, rgba(138, 24, 28, 0.2), rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 68%), radial-gradient(55% 40% at 1 | div.web-spotlight → radial-gradient(110px at 85% 10%, rgba(233, 54, 63, 0.6), rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 70%)
findings.fix: Use a flat colour or a real image. The only gradient allowed by default is a neutral scrim over a photo for legibility.

findings.message: 69 box-shadow(s) on elements at rest: a.btn-primary.group → rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.35) 0px 1px 2px 0px, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05) 0px 0px 0px 1px | a.btn-primary.group → rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.35) 0px 1px 2px 0px, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05) 0px 0px 0px 1px | div.group.premium-card → rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.55) 0px 12px 28px -16px, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.06) 0px 0px 0px 1
findings.fix: Remove. Separate surfaces with a tone step or space. Shadows are for things that really float (menus, dialogs, sticky bars).

findings.message: Buttons with gradient fill and shadow/glow.
25 thin rule(s)/divider line(s): div.signal-strip.overflow-hidden 1440px | span.relative.mt-6 334px | span.relative.mt-6 334px | span.relative.mt-6 334px
findings.fix: Delete. Separate with space, a tone change, or scale. Lines are only for real tables and form fields.
Define a surface by its fill (one tone step from the page) or leave the content unboxed.
One blurred sticky bar at most; glass cards are a tell.

findings.message: 2 row(s) of identical cards each topped with a small icon (3, 16 cards).
findings.fix: Replace with one composed section from the direction: a narrative split, a list set in large type, or real imagery per item.
A page needs about five: display, heading, lead, body, small.

findings.message: Body text is 14px (the size most of the running text is set in).
findings.fix: Body copy 16–20px. Map small sizes from blueprints onto your body step.

findings.message: Only 0 picture(s) on the page (0 photographs, footage or raster images, 0 interface fragments). Drawings in SVG do not count.
findings.fix: Find real pictures of the subject's world with scripts/assets.mjs (photographs, archival images, maps, engravings, footage), download them to assets/ and give them room: a hero picture, one per section that has a subject, a full-width band. At least four, usually six to twelve.

findings.message: No video anywhere on the page.
findings.fix: Look for one honest clip with scripts/assets.mjs --video (the place, the material, the process) and use it as a muted loop with a poster frame. Defend its absence only if no clip fits the subject.
Nothing meant to be read goes below 13px.
